title: Who Cooks for Nuclear Missile Officers 60 Feet Underground
asof: Figures from US Air Force & National Park Service · full video on the channel

shots.s: Sixty feet underground, there's no kitchen.
These officers guard nuclear missiles for twenty-four hours straight.
Upstairs, in a building that looks like a ranch house,
a missile chef cooks for everyone on site.
One chef, working alone, for ten to twenty people.
The crew picks from a menu before going down.
Then the chef brings the food down at set times.
For many crews, that's the only face they see all day.
